global_known_at_contract.retrieval_fallback_rule: Retrieval time may establish prospective availability no earlier than retrieval; it may never be substituted as an earlier publication time or backdated into historical PIT.

known_at_rules.rule: Use an archived/versioned provider publication timestamp when verified; otherwise the immutable project retrieval timestamp is only a conservative prospective upper bound and cannot be backdated into historical PIT.

Pregame state requires an immutable capture retrieved by cutoff. Outcomes, drives, plays, box scores, and advanced game statistics require source-game completion, a capture known by cutoff, and target-game exclusion.

Issued forecast use requires exact run/model availability and capture by cutoff plus forecast validity for target time. Historical observed or reanalysis weather is label/reference-only for pregame modeling.
Use verified public release/publication time for the exact report version; reporting period and season labels never establish knowability.
Use a timestamped archived publication/version or immutable capture known by cutoff. Current roster, bio, and depth pages cannot be projected backward.
Use a verified version/publication time or immutable retrieval time prospectively; never backdate a current capture or infer timing from labels.

negative_findings: The BAT-391 ledger contains no nonempty source_known_at_utc values; decision_known_at_utc cannot substitute for source timing.
The materialized population captures were acquired in 2026 and are not thereby historically knowable for 2004-2025 pregame cutoffs.
Raw fields classified REVIEW_REQUIRED remain ineligible; rule coverage does not promote them.
Schema name matches are linkage hints only and do not establish semantic identity or historical availability.
No protected split, model, metric, feature promotion, historical completeness, or scientific result is evaluated by this registry.

prohibited_uses.rule: No target-game outcome, drive, play, score, box score, final statistic, or derived target-game result may enter that game's pregame state.
No future-game event or outcome may enter an earlier cutoff.
Postgame evidence requires completion and source knowability before the later target cutoff.
Observed/reanalysis/realized weather is never substituted for an issued forecast in pregame state.
Closing or later market values cannot be used at an earlier forecast snapshot.
Final participation, starters, snap counts, and postgame roster truth cannot be used pregame unless an earlier dated report independently supports the exact fact.
Effective, valid, observed, event, and game times do not establish public knowability.
Season, week, reporting period, and fiscal labels do not establish publication or first-known time.
A later retrieval cannot be moved earlier to create historical eligibility.
Current mutable pages cannot establish historical roster, role, depth, venue, or rule state without dated archived evidence.
Project processing or decision timestamp cannot substitute for source-known-at time.
Ambiguous timing remains review-required/ineligible rather than guessed.
